The policy states: *“A preference the user stated applies to every later recommendation of the same kind.”*  
This means the memory is stored because it reflects a user preference that will govern subsequent recommendations of the same type.

The memory describes a recommendation for creating a monthly budget based on a *consistent paycheck* (i.e., a preference about financial planning).  
Thus the condition we need to satisfy is: *“The user has stated a preference regarding their paycheck consistency that should guide similar future financial recommendations.”*

No other candidate mentions paycheck consistency or financial planning preferences.
